decision.question: Fetch Contracts Finder's daily notice files since 2023, about 1.7 GB?

selection_rule: An award notice is entered when its buyer is a ledger organisation and a supplier named on the award is a ledger organisation, the award is dated from 1 January 2019 to the end of record (10 November 2026) and is active, and the ledger does not already hold the notice. Names are entered only where a research hand judged the published name to be the ledger organisation, its UK arm or a subsidiary carrying its name.
admission_rule: One surface per Contracts Finder award notice, dated by the drafted award date; one row per participant entry, dated by its own date. A buyer row is admitted when the archived release's buyer name equals its shown name; a supplier or framework_supplier row when an award of that date in the archived release names a supplier equal to its shown name, and a drafted amount equals that award's value in GBP. A surface without an admitted buyer row and an admitted supplier row goes to gaps. Nothing is minted. Every surface is hop_eligible false pending a reader: these are organisation-only records.

money.funding_amount_gbp: Value of the award on a single-supplier Contracts Finder notice (a contract value or ceiling, not money paid). Framework places carry no amount.
